turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey there, how's your day been?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I found two flights to Tokyo. One is cheaper but has a nine hour layover.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That layover is long, but you could leave the airport for a few hours. Is saving the money worth the extra travel time to you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One sec, I'm going to talk with my neighbor. Please wait until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Leo, come look at this. Is that water stain on the ceiling getting bigger?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm finished with that, what's next?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Can you help me move the table?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Hmm, yeah, it looks darker than yesterday.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Great. Do you think it's the roof or the upstairs bathroom?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's right under the tub, so my bet's the bathroom.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'll check the seal around the tub tomorrow morning.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Put a towel down in the meantime, just in case.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Back again. What were we talking about?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Welcome back. You were choosing between the two Tokyo flights.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, I'll pay more. I hate airports.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fair enough. You'll arrive much fresher, and that first day in Tokyo is worth a lot.
